title: Exotico
description: The ultimate Hypixel SkyBlock exotic armor scanner and highlighter for Minecraft 1.21.11.
body:
# Exotico ✦

**Exotico** is a premium, high-performance Minecraft mod built for **Minecraft 1.21.11**. It is specifically designed for Hypixel SkyBlock enthusiasts who want to detect, highlight, and track rare "Exotic" armor colors and glitched items.

### ✨ Key Features:

*   🔍 **Advanced Scanner:** Automatically scans players in your lobby and identifies exotic armor sets in real-time.
*   🎨 **Inventory Highlighting:** Exotic items are highlighted in your inventory, chests, and trading menus with beautiful, color-coded borders.
*   💡 **Detailed Tooltips:** Shows the exact Hex code, variant name (Fairy, Crystal, Glitched, etc.), and a description of the color.
*   🛑 **Smart Dye Filtering:** Automatically detects and filters out official Hypixel Dyes (like Chocolate Dye) to ensure only true exotics are flagged.
*   ⚙️ **Modern UI:** Access the fully custom settings screen via `/exotico settings` to configure webhooks, auto-messaging, and more.

Whether you are an exotic collector or a casual player looking for rare items, **Exotico** provides all the tools you need in one sleek, efficient package.
